# Noise-Rate-Activated Sensing

> Optimal local sensing of a Hamiltonian frequency under a shared fixed unknown transverse error direction. Classical rate diversity changes the precision law; a separate stopped protocol gives an exact direction-independent channel.

## Scientific entry points
- [Overview](README.md): Central result, two distinct output guarantees, scope, and purpose/contact.
- [Model](docs/MODEL.md): Allowed controls, shared nuisance, full Fisher pooling, charged time, and parameter normalization.
- [Theorems](docs/THEOREMS.md): All-strategy fixed-rate converse, optimal selectable-setting coefficient, preset attainment, and independent-axis bound.
- [Preset protocols](docs/PRESET_PROTOCOLS.md): Balanced echo, exact calibration penalty, recorded rate randomization, unknown-rate nuisance blocks, and finite-time local certificates.
- [Stopped sensing](docs/STOPPED_SENSING.md): Exact Ramsey channel, first-passage law, deadline accounting, and global estimation proof.
- [Physical scope](docs/PHYSICAL_SCOPE.md): Collision and stochastic models, coherent-access distinction, signal shifts, and finite-cadence local result.
- [Tutorial](docs/TUTORIAL.md): Self-directed explanation of rate diversity versus trajectory-wise cancellation.
- [Related work](literature/RELATED_WORK.md): Primary-source comparisons and explicit attribution boundaries.
- [Bibliography](literature/references.bib): Machine-readable references.

## Verification and maintenance
- [Reproducibility](docs/REPRODUCIBILITY.md): Commands, check coverage, and numerical examples.
- [Stopped reference calculations](src/nras.py): Algebra, control speed, timing laws, and event simulator.
- [Preset reference calculations](src/preset.py): Full Fisher matrices, efficient information, calibration penalty, and labelled-design coefficients.
- [Stopped tests](tests/test_nras.py): Symbolic identities, matrix products, independent optimization, and deadline-aware simulations.
- [Preset tests](tests/test_preset.py): Direct echo trajectories, complete-likelihood finite differences, rate uncertainty, and randomization bounds.
- [Agent instructions](AGENTS.md): Scope, scientific invariants, and safe repository workflow.

Treat the documents as the claim definitions and proofs, not the tests as universal evidence. Pool the full classical Fisher matrices before eliminating a shared nuisance. Preset rate selection is not feedback-free when recovery follows errors. Keep local information and global risk separate, charge every repetition and deadline failure, and distinguish statistical orthogonality from exact output independence. No bath-output access or coherent unknown-axis drive is part of the central model. Do not infer priority or experimental demonstration from numerical checks.
